integrity: Exact mathematical definitions, proof, and independently constructed finite checks are included. No outside independent assessment has been made.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to perfect semigroups with m>F/2; excluded lower-multiplicity strata and no uniqueness claim beyond inspected literature. Full text of the 2026 multiparameter comparator was unavailable, so a possible unindexed equivalent remains a priority risk. Finite checks are not an infinite proof.
title: A geometric boundary layer and Gaussian genus law for high-multiplicity perfect numerical semigroups
